market.headline: The AI selloff is spreading: Nvidia's leadership crisis and new China export trouble are pulling chips lower again before the open, after the Anthropic listing failed to lift the group. Stay out of chips today and buy only the few strong names that hold their levels.
watch: 09:30-10:30: QQQ 634.52 pre-market vs 644.34 (yesterday's low). Getting back above 644.34 means sellers are tiring.
SPY 715.65: yesterday's low and the 20-day low. Pre-market is 709.69, below it. The 200-day average at 730.2 is the line to win back.
Nov 25 08:30: GDP and PCE inflation, with the 10-year yield at 5.07 and VIX at 24.56.
market.if_then: If QQQ gets back above 644.34 by 10:30, then the GOOGL, NFLX and ORCL buys below are allowed; if QQQ is still under 634.52 at 10:30, then skip every buy today.

stocks.why: The business is not the problem. Sales are up 106% from a year ago, the operating margin is 65%, and next year's profit forecasts are up 27% in 90 days. At 9x next year's profit it is the cheapest it has been in 5 years. The stock is down 31.2% in 20 days for three other reasons: the CEO has resigned, a state attorney general is investigating chips reaching China, and there are reports that US-approved sales went to companies tied to China's military. Those can lead to fines, tighter export limits and lost China sales. Until there is a permanent leader and the probe is clearer, every new headline hits TSM, AMD, SMCI, CRWV and ORCL with it.

long_term.reason: This agrees with the house view. The numbers argue Buy, but leadership and legal risk can't be priced yet, so a cheap price alone is not enough.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A permanent CEO plus a clear answer on the China probe would turn this into a Buy at these prices.
stocks.action: Don't buy the drop today. Buy only after it closes back above 145.71, and not before next week.

levels.means: Above it = the panic is easing. Below it = sellers stay in control.
Pre-market price. Above it after the first hour = the gap is being bought. Below it = a new leg down.
Yesterday's high. Only above it is the selloff over.

stocks.if_then: If NVDA trades back above 145.71 and holds into the close, then stop the avoid and put it on the buy list for next week.

stocks.headline: Down 5.5% pre-market at 462.5, after falling 7.7% yesterday on a short-seller report linking its products to a blacklisted Chinese company.
stocks.why: The report is an accusation, not a finding. The business is strong: sales up 45%, operating margin doubled from 9% to 18%, five beats in a row, and profit forecasts up 15% in 90 days. The real risks are export penalties and the Nvidia probe widening to AMD, since the same reports on US-approved China sales name both companies. Volume yesterday was 1.9x normal, which means real selling, not a light-volume dip. The stock is still above its 200-day average, so the long rally is damaged but not broken.

long_term.reason: This agrees with the house view. The growth is real, but don't buy until the company answers the China claims.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A clear rebuttal from AMD and no regulator follow-up would make a dip toward 428.63 a Buy.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. The first long-term buy zone is near 428.63, and only after AMD answers the report.

levels.means: Yesterday's low. Back above it = the report is being shrugged off. Below it = more selling.
200-day average. Holding it = the long uptrend survives. Breaking it = the trend turns.
20-day low. Below it = the whole November rally is gone.

stocks.if_then: If AMD publishes a clear rebuttal and trades back above 470.56, then stop the avoid and wait for next week to buy.

stocks.why: Google is down 15.9% in 20 days because AI spending is rising faster than sales. Profit per share fell 26% and last quarter missed forecasts by 30%. But sales are growing a steady 25%, it holds $56.3B in cash and $567.7B in contracted backlog, and it trades at 14x last year's profit, its lowest in 5 years. It supplies computing power to Anthropic, and its new Gemini agent for the Mac shows its products are holding up. It earns from AI whichever model company wins. Holding up on a day like this is the first sign of a bottom.

long_term.reason: This agrees with the house view. It is the cheapest it has been in 5 years, with steady growth and a huge backlog. The cost squeeze is the price of the entry.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Another quarter where costs grow faster than sales with no slowdown in spending would move it to Wait.
stocks.action: Buy a first slice only if it trades back at or above 272.66 after the first hour. If it breaks 270.0, wait.

levels.means: Yesterday's close. Above it = buyers are stepping in, so buy. Below it = no entry yet.
Holding it = a base is forming. Breaking it = wait for next week.
20-day average. Back above it = the downtrend is over.

stocks.if_then: If it breaks below 270.0, then don't buy today and wait for next week.

long_term.reason: At 15x next year's profit it is cheap, but how much China sales the new controls cut is not known yet.

stocks.action: Don't buy today. Reconsider only after it closes back above 351.14.

stocks.if_then: If it trades back above 351.14, then stop the avoid.

long_term.reason: This agrees with the house view. Sales are growing 30% and speeding up at its lowest price-to-profit in 5 years. AI spending fears are the risk into the Dec 14 report.

stocks.action: Buy a first slice only if it gets back to 109.21 after the first hour. Don't buy it below that.

levels.means: Above it = the break failed, so buy. Below it = new lows, so wait.

stocks.if_then: If it is still under 106.6 at midday, then skip it today.
